post.text:
MiniMax M2.5 context benchmarks on M3 Ultra 512GB

MiniMax M2.5 is here! Weights released open on Hugging Face.
Let's make a quick context benchmark test using MLX, with:
single request (no batching VLLM style here)
no caching of previous request
Mac Studio with M3 Ultra 512GB 80 GPU cores
4,5,6 and 8 bits quantization. 
mlx_lm 0.30.7 (directly from source)
Personally I suggest 5bit and above with these settings:
temp = 1.0
top_p = 0.95
top_k = 40
Comparison
Raw results as prompt processing / text generation / peak memory:
4bit: 540 / 35.1 TPS / 161.6 GB
5bit 530.3 / 33 TPS / 190.2 GB
6bit 414.3 / 31 TPS / 218.8 GB
8bit 390.1 / 28.4 TPS / 276 GB
 
A Mac Studio with 256GB is perfect to run up to 6bit.
4bit details
Raw results as prompt processing / text generation / peak memory:
0.5k pp 474 tg 49 t/s 129.2GB
1k pp 664 tg 49 t/s 129.6GB
2k pp 797 tg 46 t/s 130.1GB
4k pp 769 tg 44 t/s 130.6GB
8k pp 708 tg 39 t/s 131.5GB
16k pp 597 tg 34 t/s 133.4GB
32k pp 450 tg 25 t/s 137.4GB
64k pp 252 tg 18 t/s 145.3GB
128k pp 149 tg 11 t/s 161.6GB
 
4bit is ok for basic tests with small context, it starts to derail around 8K.
5bit details
Raw results as prompt processing / text generation / peak memory:
0.5k pp 469 tg 46 t/s 157.8GB
1k pp 625 tg 45 t/s 158.1GB
2k pp 766 tg 43 t/s 158.7GB
4k pp 743 tg 40 t/s 159.2GB
8k pp 687 tg 37 t/s 160.1GB
16k pp 582 tg 32 t/s 162.0GB
32k pp 443 tg 25 t/s 166.0GB
64k pp 294 tg 17 t/s 173.9GB
128k pp 164 tg 11 t/s 190.2GB
 
This is the best compromise quality/speed.
6bit details
Raw results as prompt processing / text generation / peak memory:
0.5k pp 206 tg 41 t/s 186.4GB
1k pp 316 tg 41 t/s 186.6GB
2k pp 536 tg 40 t/s 187.3GB
4k pp 611 tg 38 t/s 187.8GB
8k pp 626 tg 35 t/s 188.7GB
16k pp 561 tg 30 t/s 190.5GB
32k pp 441 tg 24 t/s 194.5GB
64k pp 275 tg 17 t/s 202.5GB
128k pp 158 tg 11 t/s 218.8GB
 
My personal preference go to 6bit!
8bit details
Raw results as prompt processing / text generation / peak memory:
0.5k pp 181 tg 38 t/s 243.5GB
1k pp 280 tg 37 t/s 243.8GB
2k pp 479 tg 36 t/s 244.5GB
4k pp 572 tg 35 t/s 244.9GB
8k pp 599 tg 32 t/s 245.8GB
16k pp 546 tg 28 t/s 247.7GB
32k pp 433 tg 23 t/s 251.7GB
64k pp 267 tg 16 t/s 259.7GB
128k pp 154 tg 11 t/s 276.0GB
 
Conclusions
In real life you can use 5bit with OpenCode and the prefill slowness is less relevant, because you'll not start with a 128K context, you'll add tokens step by step to the KV Cache. 
What a model! Local AI is reaching incredible levels and M5 Ultra will unlock even more power! 🔥
